cohorts.original216: Original GPT-5.4-pro quality scores for run 1 only: 18 tasks x 4 models x 3 variants.
cohorts.corrective162: Astra quality scores: 6 tasks x 3 models x 3 variants x 3 runs.
cohorts.historical648_reproducibility: Original semantic and functional measurements over 18 x 4 x 3 three-run cells.

quality_scale: Ordinal integers 1-5, all higher is better. Legacy fabrication is renamed fabrication avoidance, not inverted.
interpretation: Neither judge is ground truth. Calibration observations and ceiling effects limit interpretation; no independent human agreement estimate is supplied.
Task-block sensitivity intervals describe composition of the fixed selected benchmark, not population confidence, judge reliability or a causal estimate.

The corrective experiment changes inputs and models, and PEIL prompts add a system message while naive prompts use a user message only. It is not an isolated causal test of labels or of adding missing inputs.
Category crosswalks are reporting views only. Broad category conclusions are withheld where mappings remain unsettled; no original classifications are rewritten.
